facts.business: The Amalgamated Electricity Co. Ltd reports nil operational revenue and an operating loss, with total liabilities exceeding total assets.

auditor.name: Vatsaraj & Co
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty on Going Concern: Nil operational revenue, operating loss, total liabilities exceed total assets by ₹72.77 Lakhs, accumulated losses have completely eroded paid-up equity capital.
